choices.title: Kuhl core desktop
choices.description: Fedora-packaged Niri, full-width Waybar, graphical Rofi launcher, Fuzzel fallback, Kitty, Mako, wallpaper and Wayland essentials. GNOME stays as fallback.

choices.title: Kuhl Frontier / six coordinated themes
choices.description: Art-led Frontier, Dyson, Puncture and Slow End palettes, plus original Kuhl Day/Dusk. Includes matched launcher, Niri, terminal, bar and notification colors; attribution and CC terms documented.

choices.title: Replace existing desktop settings (with backups)
choices.description: For upgrades: backs up and replaces existing Niri, Waybar, Kitty, Rofi, Mako and Fuzzel configurations. Off by default; requires typing REPLACE first.

choices.title: Vicinae Spotlight-style search (optional COPR)
choices.description: Optional macOS-style launcher/search, file index and clipboard tools. Explicit consent required for third-party COPR quadratech188/vicinae. Without it, Super+Space launches themed Fedora-packaged Rofi with Fuzzel fallback.

choices.title: Network, Bluetooth and audio helpers
choices.description: NetworkManager tray applet, Blueman Bluetooth interface, pavucontrol, brightnessctl and playerctl. Makes a standalone Niri session friendlier.

choices.title: Flatseal
choices.description: Inspect and edit Flatpak sandbox permissions. Uses Flathub for current user only.

choices.title: Pika Backup
choices.description: Graphical encrypted backups. Uses Flathub for current user only.
